init_ShapeNetCore_dataset: create a ShapeNetCore dataset from a data directory with optional synset categories and version 1 or 2
getitem_ShapeNetCore_model: retrieve a 3D mesh model by index returning verts, faces, textures, synset_id, model_id, and label
load_ShapeNetCore_with_textures: initialize ShapeNetCore dataset with texture loading enabled and a specified texture resolution per face
filter_ShapeNetCore_synsets: load ShapeNetCore dataset filtered to specific synset categories by offset or label names
render_ShapeNetCore_meshes: render 3D mesh models from the ShapeNetCore dataset using PyTorch3D cameras and shaders
